source.title: Simply B1 Preliminary for Schools: 8 Complete Practice Tests
source.questions: Original student-book pages supplied by the user.
source.answerKey: WordHop-authored answer key and English explanations based on the supplied recordings; not a publisher key.

parts.title: Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt: How much will the girl pay to buy a new T-shirt?
questions.explanation: She needs the shirt immediately, so she will pay the shop’s reduced price of £11.89. £16.89 is the old price and £10.50 is the online price.
questions.evidence: It’s reduced by £5, from £16.89 to £11.89.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái cần áo ngay nên sẽ trả giá đã giảm tại cửa hàng là £11.89. £16.89 là giá cũ, còn £10.50 là giá mua trên mạng.

questions.prompt: What food will the boy have?
questions.explanation: They finally agree to share a pizza. Fried chicken is the first idea, and burgers are only listed as another option.
questions.evidence: I’m going to have a pizza. Actually, why don’t we share one now that I think about it?
questions.explanationVi: Cuối cùng họ đồng ý ăn chung một chiếc pizza. Gà rán là ý tưởng ban đầu, còn bánh hamburger chỉ được nhắc như một lựa chọn khác.

questions.prompt: How will they get to the park?
questions.explanation: They agree to cycle, with one borrowing the other’s brother’s bicycle. The father is at work, and they reject the bus suggestion.
questions.evidence: It’ll be better to go by bike. You can borrow my brother’s bike.
questions.explanationVi: Họ thống nhất đi xe đạp; một người sẽ mượn xe của anh/em trai người kia. Bố đang đi làm và họ không chọn xe buýt.

questions.prompt: Where did the boy go on holiday last summer?
questions.explanation: The family eventually accepted a holiday at a beach resort. Their mountain flight was cancelled, and they did not take the city offer.
questions.evidence: We were offered a package holiday and a lovely beach resort. It was great.
questions.explanationVi: Cuối cùng gia đình nhận chuyến nghỉ ở khu nghỉ dưỡng ven biển. Chuyến bay tới vùng núi bị hủy và họ không chọn kỳ nghỉ trong thành phố.

questions.prompt: What did the girl collect from the shop today?
questions.explanation: She has obtained a new mouse. The printer is unavailable until next week and the keyboard has been ordered.
questions.evidence: Other than a new mouse. That was easy to get.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái đã lấy được chuột máy tính mới. Phải đến tuần sau mới có máy in, còn bàn phím mới chỉ được đặt hàng.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like on Saturday evening?

optionText.B: Windy weather (a wind face blowing and a tree bending).
optionText.C: Sunny weather (a sun over the landscape).

questions.explanation: Snow is forecast for Saturday evening. The strong winds are for Saturday morning, and sunshine returns on Sunday.
questions.evidence: In the evening there will be a strong chance of snow.
questions.explanationVi: Dự báo cho biết tối thứ Bảy có khả năng tuyết rơi. Gió mạnh xảy ra vào sáng thứ Bảy, còn đến Chủ nhật trời mới có nắng.

questions.prompt: What sport will the girl learn?
questions.explanation: She is interested in basketball and only needs permission for the course fee. Football and hockey are ruled out because they are outdoors.
questions.evidence: Basketball looks interesting. I’m also the right height.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái thích bóng rổ và chỉ còn cần xin phép về học phí. Cô loại bóng đá và khúc côn cầu vì hai môn này diễn ra ngoài trời.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about their trip to the museum.

The girl isn’t interested in

optionText.A: the way people lived a long time ago.
optionText.C: having anything to eat or drink.

questions.explanation: She prefers the dinosaurs and finds the historical-life section boring. She also says she would like some cake, so food is not the thing that disinterests her.
questions.evidence: I preferred the section about dinosaurs. I find this section a bit boring.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái thích khu khủng long hơn và thấy khu giới thiệu cuộc sống thời xưa khá chán. Cô vẫn muốn ăn bánh, nên không phải cô không hứng thú với đồ ăn.

questions.prompt:
You will hear a boy telling a friend about his meeting with the headteacher.

The headteacher and the history teacher

optionText.A: were disappointed by the boy’s project.
optionText.B: disagreed about the mark on the boy’s project.
optionText.C: were excited with the boy’s project.

questions.explanation: Both teachers are very happy with his project and want him to present it to the school. There is no disagreement about his high mark.
questions.evidence: They said they were very happy with my project ... They also want me to present my project in front of the whole school.
questions.explanationVi: Cả hai giáo viên đều rất hài lòng về dự án và muốn cậu trình bày trước toàn trường. Họ không bất đồng về điểm cao của cậu.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about what they did in the snow.

What did the girl crash into at the bottom of the hill?
questions.explanation: She nearly hit the children and the dog escaped, but she actually crashed into the bush.
questions.evidence: I ended up going into the bush.
questions.explanationVi: Cô suýt đâm vào bọn trẻ và con chó chạy thoát, nhưng vật cô thực sự đâm vào là bụi cây.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a swimming competition.

What will the girl do for the boy after the competition?

optionText.A: take him out to eat somewhere
optionText.C: take him to the swimming pool

questions.explanation: She promises to buy him dinner for helping her train. She refuses to share the prize money, and the pool visit is for practice before the competition.
questions.evidence: I will buy you dinner for helping me, but forget about the prize money.
questions.explanationVi: Cô hứa sẽ mua bữa tối cho cậu để cảm ơn việc giúp tập luyện. Cô không đồng ý chia tiền thưởng; đi bơi là để luyện tập trước cuộc thi.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about their day at the zoo.

What was the girl scared by?
questions.explanation: She was frightened when the tigers showed their teeth. The monkeys and the elephants’ water-throwing are described as funny.
questions.evidence: Those tigers were scary. I was frightened when they showed their teeth.
questions.explanationVi: Cô sợ khi những con hổ nhe răng. Các con khỉ và việc voi phun nước lại được cô kể là buồn cười.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about the film they saw at the cinema last night.

Why didn’t the boy enjoy the film?
questions.explanation: He thinks the main actors do not suit their roles. The film was not frightening and was too long, so the other two options do not fit.
questions.evidence: The main characters were played by two well-known actors, but I think that these roles don’t suit them.
questions.explanationVi: Cậu thấy các diễn viên chính không hợp vai. Phim không đáng sợ và quá dài, nên hai lựa chọn còn lại không phù hợp.

parts.title: Part 3
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time.
parts.heading: School Trip to the Castle
parts.context: You will hear a teacher telling a group of students about a trip they are going on.

questions.prompt: Time to meet at school gate: ________
questions.explanation: Students must arrive at 8.40; the coach leaves later at 9.10. The question asks when to meet, not when to leave.
questions.evidence: The coach will be leaving the school at 9.10, so you all need to be there at 8.40.
questions.explanationVi: Học sinh phải có mặt lúc 8.40, còn xe khởi hành lúc 9.10. Câu hỏi hỏi giờ tập trung.

questions.prompt: Need to bring: a ________
questions.explanation: The teacher corrects “book” to the more specific “notebook”. Students can use their phones for photographs.
questions.evidence: You need to bring a book, I mean a notebook with you.
questions.explanationVi: Giáo viên sửa “book” thành “notebook”, tức sổ ghi chép. Học sinh có thể dùng điện thoại để chụp ảnh.

questions.prompt: Morning activity: ________ in the garden
questions.explanation: The morning activity is a special painting class in the gardens. The teacher specifically rules out a guided tour.
questions.evidence: We will go to the gardens where we will have a special painting class.
questions.explanationVi: Hoạt động buổi sáng là một lớp học vẽ đặc biệt trong khu vườn. Giáo viên nói rõ sẽ không có chuyến tham quan với hướng dẫn viên.

questions.prompt: Afternoon activity: trip on a ________
questions.explanation: They will travel down the river by boat in the afternoon. “Boat” follows “trip on a” in the notes.
questions.evidence: We will be going on a boat down the river.
questions.explanationVi: Buổi chiều họ sẽ đi thuyền dọc dòng sông. Sau cụm “trip on a” cần từ “boat”.

questions.prompt: Hand in projects by: ________
questions.explanation: The projects must be handed in by Tuesday afternoon. The teacher explicitly rejects Wednesday morning; Friday afternoon is when the projects will be marked.
questions.evidence: Need to be handed in by Tuesday afternoon. Not Wednesday morning.
questions.explanationVi: Hạn nộp dự án là chiều thứ Ba. Giáo viên bác bỏ sáng thứ Tư; chiều thứ Sáu là lúc chấm dự án.

questions.prompt: Castle website: www.________.castle.com
questions.explanation: The teacher spells the missing website name A-R-U-N-D-E-L. Only that name is needed between “www.” and “.castle.com”.
questions.evidence: I’ll spell that for you. That’s A R U N D E L.
questions.explanationVi: Giáo viên đánh vần tên còn thiếu là A-R-U-N-D-E-L. Chỉ điền “arundel” giữa “www.” và “.castle.com”.

parts.title: Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.context: You will hear an interview with a young pilot called Omar.

questions.prompt: Omar first became interested in flying planes when

optionText.A: he first went on an aeroplane.
optionText.B: he moved to a house near an airport.
optionText.C: he played with his toy aeroplanes.

questions.explanation: His ambition began when the family moved beneath Heathrow’s flight path and he watched planes every day. His first flight and toy planes came earlier.
questions.evidence: Every day I would watch the planes. It was then that I decided to become an airline pilot.
questions.explanationVi: Anh bắt đầu muốn làm phi công khi gia đình chuyển tới nơi nằm dưới đường bay vào Heathrow và anh thấy máy bay mỗi ngày. Chuyến bay đầu tiên và máy bay đồ chơi có từ trước đó.

questions.prompt: Where did Omar’s family move to after living next to the airport?
questions.explanation: The family moved to a cottage in a small village. A town was nearby, but it was not where they lived.
questions.evidence: We moved to a nice cottage in a small village.
questions.explanationVi: Gia đình chuyển tới một ngôi nhà nhỏ trong làng. Có thị trấn ở gần, nhưng họ không sống trong thị trấn.

questions.prompt: How did Omar learn to fly?
questions.explanation: He learned through flying lessons, first bought by his father and later paid for with his own earnings. He studied literature at university.
questions.evidence: My father bought me some flying lessons.
questions.explanationVi: Anh học lái máy bay qua các buổi học: ban đầu bố trả tiền, sau đó anh tự trả bằng tiền kiếm được. Ở đại học, anh học văn.

questions.prompt: Omar started his career as a pilot flying
questions.explanation: His first paid flying work was in private helicopters. Small passenger aircraft and large jets came later.
questions.evidence: I started flying private helicopters for businessmen.
questions.explanationVi: Công việc bay có trả lương đầu tiên của anh là lái trực thăng tư nhân. Anh chỉ lái máy bay chở khách nhỏ và máy bay phản lực lớn về sau.

questions.prompt: Omar wanted to fly around the world on his own because

optionText.B: he wanted to meet new people.
optionText.C: there wasn’t enough space in the plane.

questions.explanation: Travelling alone in a small aircraft let him visit small airports and meet local people. He had friends and family but chose to travel independently.
questions.evidence: I was able to learn new things, to meet the local people and enjoy their culture.
questions.explanationVi: Đi một mình bằng máy bay nhỏ giúp anh ghé các sân bay nhỏ và gặp người địa phương. Anh có bạn bè và gia đình nhưng chủ động chọn đi một mình.

questions.prompt: Why did Omar have to make an emergency landing?

optionText.B: He didn’t have any more fuel.

questions.explanation: Heavy rain during a storm forced the landing. The lack of fuel delayed his departure afterward.
questions.evidence: I couldn’t fly, as the rain was too heavy, so I had to make an emergency landing.
questions.explanationVi: Mưa lớn trong cơn bão buộc anh phải hạ cánh. Việc thiếu nhiên liệu chỉ khiến anh chậm khởi hành sau đó.
